Behringer X-TOUCH Quick Start Guide (reseller copy of the manufacturer guide), opened 2026-11-12 (read as text): 100 H x 452 W x 301 D mm, 4.3 kg, 9 motorised 100 mm faders; rear panel: AC IN on a standard IEC receptacle (type letter not named: iec-c14 assumed, plan assumedConnectors power-in), a power switch (push in = on), REMOTE Ethernet (RTP-MIDI), two USB hub ports, USB to computer (modelled as usb-audio like the other control surfaces, it carries MIDI), MIDI in and out, foot-control jacks. Not modelled: the hub ports, MIDI, foot control (no signal type). The side profile is an estimate (the guide gives one height). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, faders, knobs and screens drawn without lettering, no photo, no logo. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess) and the side profile is an estimate drawn from the three outer sizes (no drawing opened). Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
Dealer size 452 x 301 x 100 mm, 4.3 kg (the plan source).
